spec.description: Per-execution PostgreSQL statement events from the pg_stat_ch extension in ClickHouse: latency percentiles over time, top statements, errors, load attribution, and exporter health.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sum(shared_blks_dirtied) / $__interval_s AS shared_dirtied_per_s, sum(local_blks_dirtied) / $__interval_s AS local_dirtied_per_s, sum(temp_blks_written) / $__interval_s AS temp_written_per_s FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT 100.0 * sum(shared_blks_hit) / greatest(sum(shared_blks_hit) + sum(shared_blks_read), 1) AS hit_pct FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres'))

spec.title: Time split: CPU vs I/O wait

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, avg(cpu_user_time_us + cpu_sys_time_us) / 1000 AS cpu_ms, avg(shared_blk_read_time_us + shared_blk_write_time_us + temp_blk_read_time_us + temp_blk_write_time_us) / 1000 AS io_wait_ms, avg(duration_us) / 1000 AS duration_ms FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT 100.0 * countIf(err_elevel >= 21) / greatest(count(), 1) AS error_pct FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres'))

spec.title: Error rate by database and role
spec.description: Pairs with at least one non-success event. The rollup counts err_elevel > 0, so warnings are included here.

spec.rawSql: SELECT db_name, db_user, countMerge(calls_state) AS queries, sumMerge(errors_sum_state) AS errors, round(100.0 * errors / greatest(queries, 1), 2) AS error_pct FROM pg_stat_ch.db_app_user_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) GROUP BY db_name, db_user HAVING errors > 0 ORDER BY error_pct DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, err_sqlstate, count() / $__interval_s AS eps FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) AND err_elevel >= 21 GROUP BY time, err_sqlstate ORDER BY time

spec.title: Events: enqueued / exported / dropped per second
Events lost or waiting
spec.description: Per cluster: events still waiting in the ring, and events that entered the ring but were neither exported nor are still waiting, i.e. lost in batches ClickHouse rejected. Ring-full drops are on the events-flow panel. The counters reset when an instance restarts.

options.content:
### PostgreSQL — Query telemetry (pg_stat_ch)
One event **per statement execution** from `platform-db` and `product-db`, shipped by the `pg_stat_ch` extension into ClickHouse `pg_stat_ch.events_raw` (7 days hot, 90 days total). This answers what `pg_stat_statements` cannot: **server-side p50/p95/p99 over time**, errors by SQLSTATE, load per `application_name` and role, and *what changed between two moments*. `db_name` is the cluster key (every database name is unique across clusters). While ClickHouse is unreachable events wait in the ring and are dropped once it is full; a batch the server rejects is lost — check the exporter-health row before trusting a dip.

spec.title: JIT overhead
spec.description: Statements whose JIT compile time (generation + inlining + optimization + emission) averages over 10 ms. A high jit_pct_of_total says jit_above_cost is too low for this statement.

spec.rawSql: SELECT query_id, count() AS executions, round(avg(duration_us) / 1000, 2) AS avg_total_ms, round(avg(jit_generation_time_us + jit_inlining_time_us + jit_optimization_time_us + jit_emission_time_us) / 1000, 2) AS avg_jit_ms, round(100 * avg_jit_ms / greatest(avg_total_ms, 0.001), 1) AS jit_pct_of_total FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) AND jit_functions > 0 GROUP BY query_id HAVING avg_jit_ms > 10 ORDER BY avg_jit_ms DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, quantile(0.5)(duration_us) / 1000 AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(duration_us) / 1000 AS p95_ms, quantile(0.99)(duration_us) / 1000 AS p99_ms FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

spec.title: Load by application_name and role
spec.description: Total server time per application_name and role. errors comes from the rollup and includes warnings.

spec.rawSql: SELECT application_name, db_user, countMerge(calls_state) AS calls, round(sumMerge(duration_sum_state) / 1e6, 2) AS total_s, round(arrayElement(quantilesTDigestMerge(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(duration_q_state), 3) / 1000, 2) AS p99_ms, sumMerge(errors_sum_state) AS errors FROM pg_stat_ch.db_app_user_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) GROUP BY application_name, db_user ORDER BY total_s DESC LIMIT 25

spec.title: Statements without application_name
spec.description: Every PostgreSQL client must set application_name, normally through PGAPPNAME. Each row is a role whose statements arrived with an empty application_name. Not scoped by Sessions or application_name; the table should stay empty.

spec.rawSql: SELECT db_name, db_user, countMerge(calls_state) AS statements, max(bucket) AS last_seen FROM pg_stat_ch.db_app_user_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name = '' GROUP BY db_name, db_user ORDER BY statements DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT quantile(0.5)(duration_us) / 1000 AS p50_ms FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres'))

SELECT quantile(0.95)(duration_us) / 1000 AS p95_ms FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres'))

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, db_name, quantile(0.95)(duration_us) / 1000 AS p95_ms FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) GROUP BY time, db_name ORDER BY time

SELECT quantile(0.99)(duration_us) / 1000 AS p99_ms FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres'))

spec.title: Parallel workers short
spec.description: Executions that launched fewer parallel workers than planned: max_parallel_workers or max_worker_processes was exhausted.

spec.rawSql: SELECT query_id, db_operation, count() AS executions, round(avg(parallel_workers_planned), 1) AS avg_planned, round(avg(parallel_workers_launched), 1) AS avg_launched, round(avg(parallel_workers_planned - parallel_workers_launched), 1) AS avg_missed FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) AND parallel_workers_planned > parallel_workers_launched GROUP BY query_id, db_operation ORDER BY executions * avg_missed DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, application_name, count() / $__interval_s AS rps FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) GROUP BY time, application_name ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, db_name, count() / $__interval_s AS rps FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) GROUP BY time, db_name ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, db_operation, count() / $__interval_s AS rps FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) GROUP BY time, db_operation ORDER BY time

SELECT ts, db_name, application_name, db_user, err_sqlstate, err_elevel, err_message, query_text, client_addr FROM pg_stat_ch.errors_recent WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT ts, db_name, application_name, db_user, pid, query_id, round(duration_us / 1000, 2) AS duration_ms, rows, shared_blks_read, query_text FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) ORDER BY duration_us DESC LIMIT 25

spec.title: Errors for $query_id
spec.description: Errors and warnings (err_elevel shown) for the query_id in the box, newest first. Empty box, empty table.

spec.rawSql: SELECT ts, db_name, application_name, db_user, err_sqlstate, err_elevel, err_message, query_text FROM pg_stat_ch.errors_recent WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND ${query_id:sqlstring} != '' AND query_id = toInt64OrZero(${query_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100

spec.title: Latency for $query_id
spec.description: Type a query_id (from a top-statements table) into the query_id box. Empty box, empty panel. calls_per_s is per second; avg_ms and p95_ms are milliseconds. Only the time range and Database scope it.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, count() / $__interval_s AS calls_per_s, avg(duration_us) / 1000 AS avg_ms, quantile(0.95)(duration_us) / 1000 AS p95_ms FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND ${query_id:sqlstring} != '' AND query_id = toInt64OrZero(${query_id:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT count() / greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime), 1) AS statements_per_s FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres'))

spec.title: Statements spilling to temp files (work_mem)
spec.description: Statements that wrote temp blocks: a sort or hash outgrew work_mem. avg_temp_blks is temp_blks_written per execution, in 8 kB blocks.

spec.rawSql: SELECT query_id, db_name, count() AS executions, round(avg(temp_blks_written), 1) AS avg_temp_blks, round(avg(duration_us) / 1000, 2) AS avg_ms, any(query_text) AS query_text FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) AND temp_blks_written > 0 GROUP BY query_id, db_name ORDER BY sum(temp_blks_written) DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT query_id, db_name, count() AS calls, sum(shared_blks_read) AS blks_read, round(avg(shared_blks_read), 1) AS avg_blks_read, round(avg(duration_us) / 1000, 2) AS avg_ms, any(query_text) AS query_text FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) AND shared_blks_read > 0 GROUP BY query_id, db_name ORDER BY blks_read DESC LIMIT 15

spec.title: Top statements by total time
spec.description: Read from the 5-minute rollup, which has no application_name column: the application_name variable does not filter this table, and Workload only hides only the postgres database.

spec.rawSql: SELECT query_id, db_name, db_operation, countMerge(calls_state) AS calls, round(sumMerge(duration_sum_state) / 1e6, 2) AS total_s, round(100 * sumMerge(duration_sum_state) / (SELECT sumMerge(duration_sum_state) FROM pg_stat_ch.query_stats_5m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR db_name != 'postgres')), 2) AS pct_runtime, round(arrayElement(quantilesTDigestMerge(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(duration_q_state), 1) / 1000, 2) AS p50_ms, round(arrayElement(quantilesTDigestMerge(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(duration_q_state), 2) / 1000, 2) AS p95_ms, round(arrayElement(quantilesTDigestMerge(0.5, 0.95, 0.99)(duration_q_state), 3) / 1000, 2) AS p99_ms, round(sumMerge(duration_sum_state) / greatest(countMerge(calls_state), 1) / 1000, 2) AS avg_ms, round(maxMerge(duration_max_state) / 1000, 2) AS max_ms, sumMerge(errors_sum_state) AS errors, round(100.0 * sumMerge(shared_hit_sum_state) / greatest(sumMerge(shared_hit_sum_state) + sumMerge(shared_read_sum_state), 1), 1) AS hit_pct, anyMerge(query_text_state) AS query_text FROM pg_stat_ch.query_stats_5m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR db_name != 'postgres') GROUP BY query_id, db_name, db_operation ORDER BY total_s DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sum(wal_bytes) / $__interval_s AS wal_bytes_per_s, sum(temp_blks_written) * 8192 / $__interval_s AS temp_bytes_per_s FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

spec.title: WAL records and full-page images per second

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sum(wal_records) / $__interval_s AS wal_records_per_s, sum(wal_fpi) / $__interval_s AS wal_fpi_per_s FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

spec.title: Warnings/s by SQLSTATE
spec.description: Statements that completed with a WARNING (err_elevel 19). They are not errors and are excluded from the error rate.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, err_sqlstate, count() / $__interval_s AS wps FROM pg_stat_ch.events_raw WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND db_name IN (${db_name:singlequote}) AND application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote}) AND (${scope:raw} = 1 OR (application_name NOT IN ('cnpg-instance-manager', 'cnpg_metrics_exporter') AND db_name != 'postgres')) AND err_elevel = 19 GROUP BY time, err_sqlstate ORDER BY time

spec.title: Exporter health — is the picture complete? (cnpg_pg_stat_ch_*)
PostgreSQL — Query telemetry (pg_stat_ch)
